[LSIG.1.3.2] `active_fraction` must be backed by `SeriesBackendIntervalPulse` (§[LSIG.2.2]), not by
the `mean` backing. On a boolean slot under DS's meaningful-change
discipline, `mean` computes the fraction of *assertions* that were `true`,
not the fraction of *time*; the two diverge whenever reporting is
non-uniform, which is the normal case for event-driven sensors. The
compiler must not satisfy an `active_fraction` declaration with a `mean`
backing.
